exposure: Newborns of mothers without risk factors
Newborns of mothers with alcohol and/or drug consumption
outcome: Umbilical cord parameters at birth (pH, Base excess (BE), pCO2, pO2, MetHb, COHb)
cohort: 90 full-term infants born at Elena Doamna Maternity Hospital in Iasi, between 2015-2017.
finding: Newborns from mothers who consumed alcohol and/or drugs during pregnancy showed reduced levels of cerebral and peripheral saturation 1 minute after birth.
mod_finding: 62.5% of newborns of mothers with risk factors underwent a cesarean section at low levels of cerebral saturation.
